title: The origins of the electrocardiograph as a clinical instrument
lineage: Scholarly historical account quoting Cambridge company letters and sales records. The 1905 instrument was a galvanometer; the complete electrocardiograph is recorded in 1908.

passages.note: Printed pp. 62–64 / PDF pp. 10–12: capillary electrometer limitations, 1905 Sheffield sale, 1906 Bose shipment and 27 January 1908 complete ECG delivery; appendix pp. 75–76.
Printed p. 58 / PDF p. 6: Ader’s 1897 single-wire telegraph galvanometer.
